UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Shared GoGo Account user profile stored under users/{uid}

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL (empty string or valid http/https URL up to 2048 chars)

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the GoGo account was created (immutable)

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp when the user last signed in or synced profile

GameSaveProfile.title: GameSaveProfile
GameSaveProfile.description: Per-game cloud save document stored under gameProfiles/{uid}/games/{gameId}

gameId.description: Supported GoGo game identifier matching the document ID

progress.description: Validated game save payload containing stage/level progress, stars, streaks, and clientUpdatedAtMs

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud save was written

/users/{uid}.description: Private user account profile document accessible only by the authenticated owner {uid}

/gameProfiles/{uid}/games/{gameId}.description: Private per-game cloud save document accessible only by the authenticated owner {uid} for supported games (arrowout, crystalquest)
